Yōko Hikasa (Japanese: 日笠陽子 Hikasa Yōko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Hikasa was born on July 16, 1985, in , , and she became a singer and actress as an adult. She joined the during , where she voiced Ellie. Since then, Hikasa has voiced several characters of the day before gaining her most notable role of Galar Gym Leader Bea during .
